sanidassana.p: [ saha (saddhiṃ) + nidassana ] (ti) CL=7 (A) It is together with a view. It has a nature of sight. rūpārammaṇa(Based on a form) that is viewed by cakkhuviññāṇa (eye-consciousness). (B) It is together with seeing (dhamma) that is called Cakkhuviññāṇa (eye consciousness).

R:
sanidassana：သ-နိဒဿန （တိ）
မြင်ခြင်းနှင့် တကွသော။ မြင်နိုင်သော။
DOP: nidassana n. [ S. nidarśana], 1. showing; indicating ; Abh 1158 (~e ititthaṃ ca); Vin V 164, 17 (opammaṃ °’-atthāya; Sp 1365, 24 foll. : opammaṃ attha-dassanatthāya); Vism 492, 22 (so pana attabhāvo yaṃ dhammaṃ upādāya itthī ti vā puriso ti vā saṅkhaṃ gacchati ayaṃ so ti °’-atthaṃ); Sp 863, 10 (bhikkhunā ti yena laddhaṃ tassa ~aṃ); Sv 27, 13 (evaṃsaddo … ~e [āgato]); Thī-a 15, 8 (yassā muttiyā °-vasena); Nidd-a I 379, 19 (ime ti dibbacakkhunā diṭṭhānaṃ °-vacanaṃ); — 2. an example; an illustration; evidence; a comparison ; Abh 115; Sn 137 (yathā medaṃ ~aṃ caṇḍālaputto sopāko Mātaṅgo iti vissuto); Vism 129, 20 (Vakkalitthera-vatthu c’ ettha ~aṃ); 554, 30 (paṭighosapadīpamudda-paṭibimbappakārā dhammā ~āni siyuṃ); Mp IV 25, 17 (seyyathā pī ti °’-atthe nipāto); Pj II 184, 3 (tam ev’ atthaṃ ~ena sādhetuṃ); 371, 2 (Nandamātu koṭṭhāgāraṃ viyā ti loke ~aṃ ahosi); Vv-a 13, 5 (vijju-r-ivā ti °-vacanaṃ); Sadd 80, 14 (paribhotabbo ti padassa atthibhāve khattiyo … na paribhotabbo ti pāḷī ~aṃ); 920, 29 (diṭṭhantasaṃyogo ~aṃ); — 3. appearance, sight; visibility ; Sv 997, 14 (cakkhuviññāṇasaṅkhātena saha ~enā ti sanidassanaṃ); 997, 17 (cakkhuviññāṇasaṅkhātaṃ nāssa ~an ti anidassanaṃ); As 46, 26 (daṭṭhabbabhāva-saṅkhātena saha ~enā ti sanidassanā); 46, 29 (natthi etesaṃ daṭṭhabbabhāvasaṅkhātaṃ ~an ti anidassanā); — anidassana , mfn. and n. , (what is) invisible; (what is) not accessible to sight ; D I 223, 12* (viññāṇaṃ ~aṃ anantaṃ); M I 127, 36 (ayaṃ … ākāso arūpī ~o; Ps II 101, 6 : ~o ti dassanassa cakkhuviññāṇassa anāpātho); S IV 370, 11 (~aṃ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi ~-gāmiṃ ca maggaṃ; Spk III 112, 11 : cakkhuviññāṇena apassitabbattā ~aṃ); Dhs 597 (yaṃ cakkhuṃ catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo attabhāvapariyāpanno ~o sappaṭigho yena cakkhunā … rūpaṃ sanidassanaṃ sappaṭighaṃ passi); Vibh 13, 5 (atthi rūpaṃ sanidassanaṃ atthi rūpaṃ ~aṃ); 64, 5 (cattāro khandhā ~ā); Sadd 70, 27 ; — sanidassana , mfn. , visible; accessible to sight ; Vibh 13, 4 (atthi rūpaṃ ~aṃ); Kv 333, 20 (hañci passati cakkhuṃ sotaṃ ghānaṃ jivhaṃ kāyaṃ tena vata re vattabbe pañcindriyāni ~ānī ti); Vism 8, 14* (lakkhaṇaṃ … ~-ttaṃ rūpassa, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~’-atthaṃ); Sv 997, 14 ; As 317, 1 (saddhiṃ nidassanena ~aṃ cakkhuviññāṇena passitabban ti attho).

sanidassanasappaṭigha.p: [ sanidassana + sappaṭigha ] (ti) CL=7 (Rūpārūpa) that happen together with visible and tangible. (Rūpārūpa) that happens together with the state of visible and tangible.

saniddesa.p: [ saha + niddesa ] (ti) CL=7 Niddesa explains in detail and an elaborate version.

DOP: niddesa m. [ S. nirdeśa], 1. instruction, order ; Ja V 238, 12* (°-kārī puriso; 238, 21´ : tassa ~aṃ āṇattim eva yo koci puriso karoti); — 2. (specific) mention or reading; indication ; Vism 514, 26 (kiñcāpi hi pāḷiyaṃ sīlakkhandhe ti bhummena ~o kato attho pana karaṇavasen’ eva veditabbo); Sp 107, 23 foll. (kasmā yathā suttante ekaṃ samayan ti upayogavacanena ~o kato … tathā akatvā idha tena samayenā ti karaṇavacanena ~o kato ti); Vv-a 154, 22 (puññapekkhāna pāṇinan ti anunāsikalopaṃ katvā ~o); Pv-a 147, 26 (sattā ti vibhattilopena ~o); Thī-a 270, 11 (kathaṃ ehibhikkhunī ti vibhaṅge ~o kato ti); Nidd-a I 1, 16* (pāṭho visiṭṭho ~o); — ifc see ukkaṭṭha- ( sv ukkaṃsati ); — 3. detailed explanation; specification ; Vism 267, 17 (ayaṃ ettha pāḷivaṇṇanā pubbaṅgamo ~o); 498, 24 (catunnaṃ saccānaṃ ~e jāti-ādayo dhammā vuttā); Nett 4, 28* (akkharaṃ padaṃ vyañjanaṃ niruttī tath’ eva ~o) ≠ Sadd 907, 3 ; Sp 534, 28 (ummasanāya ca ullaṅghanāya ca ~e uddhaṃ uccāranā ti ekam eva padaṃ vuttaṃ, so read with Be, Ce, Se; see Vin III 121, 18 foll. ); Nidd-a I 3, 21 foll. (nibbacanavitthāro nissesato deso ti ~o … atthavitthāro niravasesena kathitattā ~o nāma, Be, Se so; Ce atthavitthārassa; Ee atthavitthāraniddhāravasena); 5, 15 (bhagavā … niruttīhi uttānīkaroti ~ehi paññāpayati); 11, 7 (kāmaṃ kāmayamānassā ti evamādi uddeso, kāmā ti uddānato dve kāmā vatthukāmā kilesakāmā cā ti evamādi ~o); 287, 27 (imassā gāthāya ~o uttānattho); Paṭis-a 116, 19 (tāsaṃ abhidhamme evaṃ ~o kato); 553, 7 (katamo ti-ādike uddesassa ~e); As 152, 26 (tasmiṃ kho pana samaye cattāro khandhā hontī ti evamādiko uddeso katame tasmiṃ samaye cattāro khandhā ti-ādiko ~o); Vibh-a 367, 15 (ten’ ev’ assa ~e; see Vibh 251, 23 ); Sadd 920, 14 (samāsavacanaṃ uddeso vitthāravacanaṃ ~o); — ifc see kattu-, kattāra- ( sv katta[r] 1 ); — 4. the name of one of the texts making up the Khuddaka-nikāya of the Pāḷi Canon; the Niddesa (the Mahāniddesa, a commentary on Sn 766–975 ; and the Cūḷaniddesa (or Cullaniddesa ), a commentary on Sn 976–1149 and Sn 35–75); Nidd II 73, 7* (~ā duvidhā ñeyyā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr niddessā); Vism 24, 4 (mahāniddese tividhaṃ kuhanavatthu āgataṃ); 209, 22 (sabbo pi °-nayo vā paṭisambhidānayo vā vitthāretabbo); Sp 695, 25 (mahābhaye kira ekass’ eva bhikkhuno mahāniddeso paguṇo ahosi); Sv 15, 22 (tato paraṃ jātakaṃ ~o paṭisambhidāmaggo apadānaṃ suttanipāto …, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee mahāniddeso cūḷaniddeso) ≠ Mp III 159, 8 ≠ Pj I 12, 9 ; Sv 394, 7 (sabbaṃ cūḷaniddese vuttanayen’ eva veditabbaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee mahāniddese, prob. wr; see Nidd II ad Sn 1037); Ps I 153, 12 (ayaṃ ettha saṅkhepo, vitthāro pana mahāniddese vuttanayen’ eva veditabbo); Cp-a 11, 3 (tathā hi vuttaṃ ~e); Dīp 5:37 (te bhikkhū … parivāraṃ … paṭisambhidaṃ ca ~aṃ … vissajjetvāna aññāni kariṃsu te); Sadd 13, 6* (yo pāṭho ~e); 389, 5 (āyasmā pi Sāriputto ~e … vattamānavacanena atthaṃ niddisi); — niddese in Ee at Ud-a 5, 12* is wr for niddise ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — niddesaṃ in Ee at Th-a II 274, 14 is wr for niddosaṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — niddesavatthūni in Ee at D III 252, 16 is wr for niddasa- ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — mahāniddesaṭṭhakathā , f. , the commentary on the Mahāniddesa; Nidd-a I 91, 30 (saddhammapajjotikāya ~āya kāmasuttaniddesavaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā); — mahāniddesavaṇṇanā , f. , the commentary on the Mahāniddesa; Nidd-a I 471, 16 (~ā samattā); — saniddesa , mfn. , with the specification ; Vin V 114, 2 (upasampadaṃ pucchissaṃ sanidānaṃ ~aṃ; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] III 470, 4 : puggalādiniddesena).

sanidāna.p: [ saha + nidāna ] (ti) CL=7 (1) (A) It happens together with a cause. (B) It is together with the root cause that is the source of the rule of Vaniya. Sanidānasutta.

R:
sanidāna：သ-နိဒါန （တိ）
အကြောင်းနှင့် တကွသော။
DOP: nidāna n. [ S., BHS id. ], 1. cause, ground; underlying and determining factor; antecedent; occasion ; Abh 91 (~aṃ pabhavo hetu); Vin III 20, 15 (bhagavā etasmiṃ ~e etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Sudinnaṃ paṭipucchi; Sp 219, 8 : ettha Sudinnassa ajjhācāravītikkamo sikkhāpadapaññattiyā kāraṇattā ~aṃ c’ eva pakaraṇaṃ cā ti vutto); D II 57, 16 (es’ eva hetu etaṃ ~aṃ esa samudayo esa paccayo jarāmaraṇassa yadidaṃ jāti); A I 134, 15 foll. (tīṇ’ imāni bhikkhave ~āni kammānaṃ samudayāya); Ja I 146, 11 (kāyo … sokānaṃ ~aṃ paridevānaṃ vatthu); Mil 272, 13 (roguppattiṃ ca ~aṃ ca sabhāvaṃ ca … jānitvā); Vism 104, 21 (paṭisandhijanakaṃ kammaṃ cariyānaṃ ~an ti); 478, 36 (°-ttā); 533, 3 (paccayo hetu kāraṇaṃ ~aṃ sambhavo pabhavo ti ādi atthato ekaṃ vyañjanato nānaṃ); Sv 471, 34 (idaṃ dānaṃ nāma sukhānaṃ ~aṃ); Ps II 18, 11 (kāraṇaṃ hi yasmā phalaṃ nideti handa naṃ gaṇhathā ti appeti viya tasmā ~an ti vuccati); Pv-a 253, 9 (yaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ dānaṃ nāma anugāmikaṃ ~an ti vadanti, Ce, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Se anugāmikanidhī ti); Paṭis-a 524, 26 (nicchayena dadāti phalam iti ~aṃ); Mhv 37:133 (~aṃ tassa pucchiya); — ifc see ito-, kuto-, chandā- ( sv chanda 1 ), tato-, yato-; — 2. preamble; introduction (giving occasion, setting, context) ; Vin I 112, 11 (~aṃ uddisitvā avasesaṃ sutena sāvetabbaṃ; Sp 1057, 15 : suṇātu me bhante saṅgho … āvikatā hi ’ssa phāsu hotī ti imaṃ ~aṃ uddisitvā; see Vin I 102, 33 foll. ); II 286, 27 (āyasmā Mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ Upāliṃ paṭhamassa pārājikassa vatthuṃ pi pucchi ~aṃ pi pucchi puggalaṃ pi pucchi …); S V 172, 5 (taṃ yeva ~aṃ); Ja I 2, 2 (sā panāyaṃ jātakassa atthavaṇṇanā dūrenidānaṃ avidūrenidānaṃ santikenidānan ti imāni tīṇi ~āni dassetvā vaṇṇiyamānā); Ap 43, 14 (~e pariyosāne sabbattha kovido ahaṃ); Vism 213, 23 (ekānusandhikaṃ suttaṃ ~ena ādikalyāṇaṃ nigamanena pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sesena majjhe kalyāṇaṃ); Sp 1367, 8 (idaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ asukasmiṃ nāma nagare paññattan ti evaṃ ~aṃ na jānāti); Sv 50, 18 (imassa suttassa … kāladesadesakavatthuparisāpadesa-patimaṇḍitaṃ ~aṃ bhāsitaṃ); Ps I 3, 1 (evaṃ me sutan ti-ādikaṃ ~aṃ); Pj II 580, 30 (āyasmā Ānando saṅgītikāle pārāyanavaggassa ~aṃ āropento imā gāthāyo abhāsi); Ap-a 284, 2 (tena samayenā ti-ādike ~e); As 29, 32 (jātakasuttanipātadhammapadādīnaṃ evarūpaṃ ~aṃ natthi); — ifc see avidūre- ( sv vidūra ), dūre- ( sv dūra ), santike-; — 3. a rope, a halter ;? — ifc see icchā-; — °- paṭhanakusala , mfn. , knowledgeable about preambles and recitation ;? Mil 344, 6 (bhikkhū vinayaññū vinayakovidā ~ā, Ce, Ee so; Be ṭhānāṭhānakusalā; Se °-vatthukusalā); — °- vatiṃ in Ee at A II 22, 26 and Nidd I 220, 22 is wr for nidhānavatiṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — anidāna , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) without a cause; without antecedents ; M II 9, 26 ; S V 213, 17 (dukkhindriyaṃ … animittaṃ ~aṃ asaṅkhāraṃ appaccayaṃ); A I 82, 22 ; — ~aṃ, adv. , without a cause ; S II 151, 10 ; — 2. ( n. ) (what is) not a cause ;? Nidd-a I 79, 24 (~ena saha); — anidānavatiṃ in Ee at A II 22, 21 is wr for anidhānavatiṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — sanidāna , mfn. , 1. with a cause, with antecedents ; M II 9, 26 (~aṃ samaṇo Gotamo dhammaṃ deseti no anidānaṃ; Ps III 241, 17 : ~an ti sappaccayaṃ); S V 213, 16 ; A I 82, 21 ; — ~aṃ, adv. , with a cause ; S II 151, 9 (~aṃ bhikkhave uppajjati kāmavitakko no anidānaṃ; Spk II 135, 30 : ~an ti bhāvanapuṃsakaṃ etaṃ, ~o sappaccayo hutvā uppajjatī ti attho); — 2. with its introduction ; Vin V 114, 2 (upasampadaṃ pucchissaṃ ~aṃ saniddesaṃ); — see also araññanidānaka ( sv arañña ).

sanighaṇḍu.p: [ saha + nighaṇḍu + vacanīyavācakabhāvena atthaṃ,] (ti) CL=7 [Saddañca nikhaḍati bhindati vibha jjadassatīti nikhaṇḍu, sāeva idhakhakārassa ghakāraṃ katvā nighaṇḍūti vutto. Dī, ṭī, 1. 291. Sārattha, 1. 121. (pu) nighaṃṭu - saṃ. Ṇighaṃṭu - prā.] It is together with Abhidhāna Book.

DOP: nighaṇḍu m. [ S. nighaṇṭu], a collection of words; lexicography ; Abh 111; Ap 502, 25 (niruttiyā ca kusalo ~umhi visārado, Be, Ce so; Ee wr nighaṇṭe ca; Se nighaṇḍe ca); Mil 178, 16 (… itihāsaṃ purāṇaṃ ~u keṭubhaṃ …); Sv 247, 21 foll. (saha ~unā … ~ū ti nāmanighaṇḍu rukkhādīnaṃ vevacanappakāsakaṃ satthaṃ; Sv-pṭ I 379, 13 : vacanīyavācakabhāvena atthaṃ saddaṃ ca nikhaḍati bhindati vibhajja dassetī ti nikhaṇṭu, sā eva idha khakārassa ghakāraṃ katvā ~ū ti vuttā, Be so; Ee omits nikhaḍati; = Sp-ṭ [ Be ] I 121, 3 : … nikhaṇḍeti bhindati vibhajja dassetī ti nikhaṇṭu …) = Mp II 261, 18 ; Ap-a 219, 31 (~uyā saha vattatī ti sanighaṇḍu, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr nigaṇḍuyā … sanigaṇḍu); Sadd 622, 23 (gho khassa ~u); — sanighaṇḍu , mfn. , together with lexicography ; Ap-a 219, 31 (~u, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr sanigaṇḍu); — ~-keṭubha, mfn. , together with lexicography and ritual science ; D I 88, 5 (tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū ~-keṭubhānaṃ) ≠ A I 163, 12 ≠ Sn p. 105, 1 ; Mil 10, 13 (tīsu vedesu ~-keṭubhesu); — ~-sakeṭubha, mfn. , id. , Sn 1020; Ap 160, 3 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr sanighaṇḍhu-; Ap-a 219, 32 : ~-sakeṭubhe vedattaye); — sanighaṇḍunā in Ee at Sv 247, 21 is wr for saha nighaṇḍunā ( Be, Ce, Se so ).

sanighaṇḍukeṭubha.p: [ saha + nighaṇḍu + keṭubha ] (ti) CL=7 It is together with Abhidhāna Book and Alaṅkā Book.

sanimitta.p: [ saha + nimitta.] (ti) CL=7 [See - Sacakka]. (1) (A) It happens together with the sign (omen) of loathsomeness. (B) It happens together with the sign (omen) of gem etc., (Bahubbīhisamāsa). (B) Together with the sign of gem, etc., (abyayībho). (prañña, sya, 1. 483 - 4 ) - See. (2) It happens together with a cause sign.

R: sanimitta：သ-နိမိတ္တ သ-နိဒါန
DOP: nimitta m.n. [ cf S., BHS nimitta], a sign, a mark; what one notes or marks ; 1. ( n. ) what is free from marks or attributes; of which nothing can be predicated ; S I 188, 23* (~aṃ ca bhāvehi; Spk I 272, 3 : niccādīnaṃ nimittānaṃ ugghāṭitattā vipassanā ~ā nāma) = Sn 342 ≠ Thī 105; Paṭis I 15, 6 (nimittaṃ saṅkhārā ~aṃ nibbānan ti abhiññeyyaṃ); 66, 20 (nimittaṃ abhibhuyyitvā ~aṃ pakkhandatī ti gotrabhū); Kv-a 180, 5 (~an ti sabbanimittarahitaṃ nibbānaṃ); — 3. ( mfn. ) without a reason or cause ; S V 213, 17 (taṃ ca ~aṃ anidānaṃ asaṅkhāraṃ appaccayaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ uppajjissatī ti n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati); A I 82, 19 (sanimittā bhikkhave uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā no ~ā); — dunnimitta , n. , a bad omen; a sign of trouble ; Bv-a 288, 21 (idāni Māro āgamissatī ti paṭhamam eva anekarūpāni aniṭṭhāni ~āni pāturahesuṃ); Cp-a 93, 10 (ajja me dussupinaṃ diṭṭhaṃ ~āni ca uppannāni); — sanimitta , mfn. , 1. having a cause; arising from a cause ; S V 213, 16 (uppannaṃ kho me idaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ, taṃ ca kho ~aṃ sanidānaṃ sasaṅkhāraṃ sappaccayaṃ); A I 82, 18 (~ā bhikkhave uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā no animittā; Mp II 154, 2 : ~ā ti sakāraṇā); — 2. associated with attributes ;? As 223, 15 (vipassanā … nimittadhammesu caratī ti ~ā va hoti); — see also tannimittaka ( sv ta[d] ).

sānisaṃsa.p: [ saha + ānisaṃsa ] (ti) Google Translate Benefit-power-with-being-there.

DOP: ānisaṃsa m. ( and n. ) [ cf BHS ā̆nuśaṃsa, ā̆nuśaṃsā; cf also S. ānṛśaṃsa, ānṛśaṃsya, “absence of cruelty or harm” ], profit, advantage; benefit, blessing (in, loc.) ; Abh 767; Vin I 221, 22 (das’ ime … ~ā yāguyā); D I 110, 3 (kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ nekkhamme ~aṃ pakāsesi); A IV 439, 30 (nekkhamme ~o anadhigato); Sn 784 (yad attanī passati ~aṃ); Th 303 (es’ ~o dhamme suciṇṇe na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī); Ja I 98, 25 (mayi purato gacchante bahū ~ā); V 490, 27* (saccena kiṃ passasi ~aṃ); Ap 387, 18 ; Peṭ 28, 15 (pañc’ ~ā pāṭikaṅkhā); 66, 5 (ekādas’ ~ā mettāya cetovimuttiyā); Mil 209, 17 (evaṃ te arahanto ~aṃ disvā disāvidisaṃ pakkantā ti); 212, 22 (ayaṃ tāva paṭhamo ~o vihāradāne); Vism 372, 17 (ayaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārādi pañcavidho samādhibhāvanāya ~o); Sp 685, 30 (evaṃ bahūni hi ettha ~ānī ti); 1107, 18 (sabbe pacchimikā gaṇapūrakā honti ~aṃ na labhanti ~o itaresaṃ yeva hoti); Paṭis-a 478, 17 (maggo hi samathavipassanānaṃ °-ttā viseso ti vutto); Cp-a 331, 32 (ete pi mahāpurisassa pāramīnaṃ ~ā ti veditabbā); Vin-vn 2711 (~am ath’ ādāya); — ifc see itivāda-(p)pamokkh’- sv iti ; — °- dassāvi(n) , mfn. , seeing the benefit; realising the advantage ; Kv 400, 2 (~issa saṃyojanānaṃ pahānan ti); Vism 189, 2 (evaṃ ~inā bhavitabbaṃ); 194, 25 (~ino pupphachaḍḍakassa); It-a I 170, 19 (tīsu sikkhāsu ~ino hutvā … viharathā ti); Paṭis-a 536, 35 (saddhindriye ~ī … asaddhiyaṃ pajahati); As 75, 28 (°-dassāvitā); — sānisaṃsa , mfn. , with its benefits or advantages ; Vism 710, 28 (~ā paññābhāvanā paridīpitā hotī ti); Spk I 41, 31 (kālaṃ nāma katheti akālaṃ nāma katheti sahetukaṃ katheti ~an ti); Pj II 214, 23 (tisso sikkhā sa-upakārā ~ā ca vuttā).
